block.create_construction_site.excavator: _Digs_ loose material when a _contraption_ pushes it in. Place several together for a _bigger bucket_.
Scoops up _diggable blocks_ until it is _full_.
_Pours out_ its load. The emptier it is, the _steeper_ it must tip.
Cycles the _mount_. _Sneak_ to pick up a whole _slice_.
Ties to the _ring_ on its middle tooth.
block.create_construction_site.bulldozer: _Pushes_ loose material along as a _pile_ and _fills holes_ on the way. Place several together for a _bigger blade_.
Takes _diggable blocks_ onto its pile; when full, the rest goes off its _end_.
create_construction_site.configuration.c: When a tool of this mod digs a block, the diggable blocks standing directly on top of it fall down. Off: they stay floating, as in plain Minecraft.
How many blocks above one dug block fall down at most.
create_construction_site.ponder.excavato: Sizes and the Wrench
Excavator Buckets dig loose material and carry it when a moving contraption pushes them into it
A bucket is 1, 2 or 3 blocks high, and as deep as it is high
Bucket blocks placed beside a bucket make it wider
A bucket can be up to 3 blocks wide when 1 high, 5 when 2 high and 7 when 3 high
Use a Wrench to move the mount: from the back, to hidden, to the top, and back again
Sneak and use a Wrench to pick up a whole slice of a bucket
Digging
On a moving contraption, such as this Gantry, an Excavator Bucket pushed open side first into loose material digs it
It takes the diggable blocks its opening and teeth reach, as long as it has room
Diggable blocks standing on a dug block come down
A bucket holds one block for each of its blocks, and shows its load inside
Emptying
On a moving contraption, an Excavator Bucket empties when it is tipped so its open side points down
The load comes out as a stream, newest blocks first, falls, and lands as a heap
A full bucket starts to spill at about 20 degrees; the last block leaves at about 45
Tying a Rope
Each block of a bucket's width takes one Create Aeronautics rope, tied to its middle tooth
The other end needs another rope holder, such as a Rope Connector, here placed on a log. A rope cannot be tied to a plain block
With it, an excavator can pull or lift things
On Simulated Contraptions
Excavator Buckets also work on Create Aeronautics' simulated contraptions, such as vehicles
They dig, carry and empty the same way, by how the contraption moves them
create_construction_site.ponder.bulldoze: On a moving contraption, a Bulldozer Blade pushes the loose material in front of it
Blade blocks placed on top of each other make a taller blade, up to 3 blocks high
Blade blocks placed beside a blade make it wider
A blade can be up to 9 blocks wide, whatever its height
Use a Wrench to switch the mount on the back: arms in the middle, at the ends, or hidden
Pushing a Pile and Filling Gaps
On a moving contraption, such as this Gantry, a Bulldozer Blade pushes the loose material in front of it
It takes diggable blocks such as dirt, sand and gravel, at its own height, and carries them as a pile
Each block of width carries 1 block on a blade 1 high, 4 on a blade 2 high and 9 on a blade 3 high
When the pile passes over a gap, blocks drop into it and fill it
This is how a blade fills trenches and levels the ground
When the Blade is Full, and Backing Away
On a moving contraption, a Bulldozer Blade carries only as much as its pile can hold
When the blade is full, it moves further blocks off its nearer end, where they form a ridge
When the blade backs away, it leaves its pile on the ground as it was
Bulldozer Blades also work on Create Aeronautics' simulated contraptions, such as vehicles
They push, fill gaps and leave their pile the same way, by how the contraption moves them
create_construction_site.ponder.tag.cons: Tools that dig, push, carry and tip material when a contraption moves them
block.create_construction_site.dump_body: _Carries_ loose material and _tips it out_. Place several together for a _bigger body_.
_Catches_ and _holds_ it, one block per Dump Body block.
Empties over its lowest _open side_, or its _top_ when upside down.
_Opens_ or _closes_ the clicked side. New ones are _closed_.
When placed on a Dump Body
Adds a _whole layer_ at once. _Sneak_ for a single block.
create_construction_site.ponder.dump_bod: Sizes and the Wrench
A Dump Body carries loose material on a contraption and tips it out
Dump Body blocks placed together join into one open-top box, up to 7 wide, 15 long and 4 high
A Dump Body placed on a full side of one adds that whole layer at once. Sneak to place a single block
Every block holds one block of material, so this one holds 30
A new Dump Body is closed on all sides; each shows a locking bar
Loading
Material that falls into a Dump Body is stored in it, also when it stands on the ground
It is shown inside the body, never higher than its walls. In a deep body, material heaps and then spreads
Engineer's Goggles show how full it is and what it holds
Tipping
On a moving contraption, such as this Mechanical Bearing, a Dump Body empties when it is tilted
With the low side closed, nothing comes out: the load only slides against the wall
Use a Wrench to open that side into a tailgate
Now the tailgate swings open, hanging straight down, and the load streams out from the low end
A full body starts at about 20 degrees; the last blocks leave at about 45. The side that points down the most is the one that opens
On Simulated Contraptions
A Dump Body also works on Create Aeronautics' simulated contraptions. Here, as one example of many, a Swivel Bearing tips it, as on a dump truck
On a simulated contraption it catches, holds and empties the same way: over its lowest open side
Use a Wrench on a side to make it a tailgate, which opens when the body is tipped toward it. Wrench it again to close it
